_comment: HELM-HA-1 §1 item 5 (OPTIONAL) — a curated, hand-maintained overlay of §27.4 gate_policy/gate_role/gate_threshold onto specific compiled packs' nodes. compile-packs.mjs applies this by workflow_id/node_id EVERY run (packs/ is fully wiped+regenerated each time), so it survives a re-compile without editing site chaingraph.json (out of HELM-HA-1's fence) or hand-authoring a pack file (would be deleted on the next compile). Additive only — a node with no matching entry here is byte-identical to before this WU.
